verdict.rationale: Belvo is a financial-data aggregator, so link repair is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack covers link creation, recurrent links with weekly refresh and webhooks, a customizable Connect Widget, and an API errors page. None of it documents link statuses for expired or revoked connections, or a re-authentication/update flow that repairs an existing link without starting over. Without first-party evidence of either part of the story, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an ops lead, broken connections are repairable — expired or revoked links surface as documented statuses, and users can re-authenticate in an update flow without starting over
